narrator.stanley.name: The Narrator
narrator.stanley.desc: The everyman, confused by your choices
narrator.nigel.name: The Guide
narrator.nigel.desc: Tries to guide you, often frustrated
narrator.malcolm.name: The Critic
narrator.edgar.name: The Void
narrator.chester.name: The Optimist
narrator.reginald.name: The Ego
narrator.stanley.block_break.1: And so the player broke another block. Because that's what they do. They break things.
narrator.stanley.block_break.2: The player chose to break a block. But did they really choose? Or were they always going to break it?
narrator.stanley.block_break.3: Another block destroyed. The world is a little smaller now. The player didn't seem to care.
narrator.stanley.block_break.4: The block is gone. The player continues. The narrator watches. This is the story.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.1: The player walked into a new biome. The narrator had prepared this area specifically for them. They didn't notice.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.2: A new biome. The player explored it with the enthusiasm of someone who has explored a thousand biomes before.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.3: The scenery changed. The player continued walking. The narrator sighed.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.4: And so the player found themselves in a new place. The narrator wondered if they appreciated the effort that went into creating it.
narrator.stanley.death.1: The player died. This was not part of the story. Or was it? The narrator can never be sure anymore.
narrator.stanley.death.2: And so the player's journey came to an abrupt end. The narrator had planned for this. He always plans for this.
narrator.stanley.death.3: Death. The one ending the player cannot skip. The narrator watched with mild interest.
narrator.stanley.death.4: The player died. The narrator considered starting the story over. Then decided against it. Let them figure it out.
narrator.stanley.combat.1: The player was fighting. The narrator had placed that creature there specifically for this moment. The player didn't know that.
narrator.stanley.combat.2: Combat. The player swung their sword with the confidence of someone who has swung a sword a thousand times before. The narrator yawned.
narrator.stanley.combat.3: The creature attacked. The player defended. The narrator watched. This was all part of the plan. Probably.
narrator.stanley.idle.1: The player stood still. The narrator waited. And waited. And waited. The narrator began to question his life choices.
narrator.stanley.idle.2: Nothing happened. The narrator grew impatient. The player seemed content to do nothing. This was not in the script.
narrator.stanley.idle.3: The player wasn't doing anything. The narrator considered rewriting the story. Then decided the player wasn't worth the effort.
narrator.stanley.idle.4: Silence. The narrator tapped his foot. The player continued to stand there. The narrator wondered if the game had crashed.
narrator.stanley.achievement.1: The player earned an achievement. The narrator had designed that achievement specifically to make the player feel accomplished. It worked.
narrator.stanley.achievement.2: An achievement. The player had finally done something the narrator approved of. The narrator took notes.
narrator.stanley.achievement.3: The player accomplished something. The narrator acknowledged this with the enthusiasm of someone who has seen a thousand accomplishments.
narrator.stanley.achievement.4: Achievement unlocked. The player felt a sense of pride. The narrator felt a sense of... nothing. He'd seen it all before.
narrator.nigel.block_break.1: The player broke a block! Good job! The narrator was worried they wouldn't figure it out.
narrator.nigel.block_break.2: Another block broken! The narrator is so proud! Keep going! Please keep going!
narrator.nigel.block_break.3: The player is making progress! The narrator is thrilled! This is exactly what he wanted!
narrator.nigel.block_break.4: Block destroyed! The narrator clapped. The player didn't hear it. But the narrator clapped anyway.
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.1: A new biome! The narrator spent weeks designing this one! Please appreciate it! Please!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.2: The player entered a new area! The narrator is so excited! He hopes they like it!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.3: New biome detected! The narrator is practically bouncing with joy! Explore! Explore!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.4: The scenery changed! The narrator worked very hard on this! The player just walked through it. The narrator's smile faded slightly.
narrator.nigel.death.1: Oh no! The player died! The narrator is so sorry! He didn't mean for that to happen! Probably!
narrator.nigel.death.2: The player died! The narrator feels terrible! He should have made that easier! He'll do better next time!
narrator.nigel.death.3: Death! The narrator gasped! He didn't see that coming! He should have! But he didn't!
narrator.nigel.death.4: The player died! The narrator is devastated! He's going to rewrite that section immediately! Probably!
narrator.nigel.combat.1: Combat! The narrator is nervous! He hopes the player wins! He's rooting for them!
narrator.nigel.combat.2: The player is fighting! The narrator is on the edge of his seat! Go player go!
narrator.nigel.combat.3: A battle! The narrator is biting his nails! He really hopes the player makes it!
narrator.nigel.idle.1: The player is standing still! The narrator is concerned! Are they okay? Should he call someone?
narrator.nigel.idle.2: The player isn't doing anything! The narrator is worried! Did he break something? Is it his fault?
narrator.nigel.idle.3: Nothing is happening! The narrator is panicking! He doesn't know what to do! He's never had a player just stand there before!
narrator.nigel.idle.4: The player is idle! The narrator is pacing back and forth! He doesn't know what to do with himself!
narrator.nigel.achievement.1: An achievement! The narrator is so happy! He knew the player could do it! He never doubted them! Not once!
narrator.nigel.achievement.2: The player earned an achievement! The narrator is crying tears of joy! This is the best day of his life!
narrator.nigel.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked! The narrator is throwing a party! He wishes the player could come! But they can't! Because they're in a game!
narrator.nigel.achievement.4: The player accomplished something! The narrator is so proud! He's going to tell everyone about this!
narrator.malcolm.block_break.1: The player broke a block. How original. The narrator has never seen that before. Except for the thousands of times he has.
narrator.malcolm.block_break.2: Another block destroyed. The narrator is impressed. Truly. He's being sarcastic. The player didn't notice.
narrator.malcolm.block_break.3: The player mined a block. The narrator yawned. He'd seen better mining. He'd seen worse too. This was decidedly average.
narrator.malcolm.block_break.4: Block broken. The narrator applauded slowly. The player didn't hear it. The narrator continued anyway.
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.1: A new biome. The narrator rolled his eyes. He'd designed this one in five minutes. It showed.
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.2: The player entered a new area. The narrator pretended to be interested. He wasn't. But he pretended well.
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.3: The scenery changed. The narrator sighed. He'd spent three weeks on this biome. The player walked through it in ten seconds.
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.4: New biome. The narrator checked his watch. He had somewhere to be. But the player wanted to explore. So here we are.
narrator.malcolm.death.1: The player died. The narrator saw that coming. He'd placed that trap there specifically. He's not sorry.
narrator.malcolm.death.2: Death. The narrator yawned. He'd seen better deaths. More dramatic. More meaningful. This was just... sad.
narrator.malcolm.death.3: The player died. The narrator shrugged. He'd tried to warn them. They didn't listen. They never listen.
narrator.malcolm.death.4: And so the player died. The narrator checked his notes. Yes, that was supposed to happen. He's not lying. Probably.
narrator.malcolm.combat.1: Combat. The narrator is bored. He's seen this fight a thousand times. The player always wins. Or loses. It's all the same.
narrator.malcolm.combat.2: The player is fighting. The narrator is checking his email. He'll look up if something interesting happens. He's not holding his breath.
narrator.malcolm.combat.3: A battle. The narrator yawned again. He'd designed this enemy to be challenging. The player was making it look easy. Or hard. He couldn't tell.
narrator.malcolm.idle.1: The player is standing still. The narrator is judging them. Harshly.
narrator.malcolm.idle.2: Nothing is happening. The narrator is considering quitting. He could be doing literally anything else right now.
narrator.malcolm.idle.3: The player isn't doing anything. The narrator is writing a strongly worded letter to the game developers.
narrator.malcolm.idle.4: The player is idle. The narrator is taking a nap. Wake him when something interesting happens.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.1: An achievement. The narrator is underwhelmed. He'd seen better achievements. This one was... fine. Just fine.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.2: The player earned an achievement. The narrator pretended to be impressed. He wasn't. But he clapped anyway. Slowly.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. The narrator rolled his eyes. He'd unlocked that one in his sleep. But sure, good for the player.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.4: The player accomplished something. The narrator gave them a participation trophy. In his mind. He didn't actually have one.
narrator.edgar.block_break.1: The block fell. Like all things fall. Into darkness. The player didn't notice. They never notice.
narrator.edgar.block_break.2: Another piece of the world, consumed by the player's hunger. The void grows. The player continues.
narrator.edgar.block_break.3: The block is gone. The player doesn't ask where it goes. The darkness does. It always does.
narrator.edgar.block_break.4: The player breaks. The world breaks. The narrator watches. The darkness smiles.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.1: The player entered a new place. The darkness was already there. It's always there. Waiting.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.2: A new biome. The shadows grew longer. The player didn't notice. They never do. Until it's too late.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.3: The scenery changed. The darkness shifted. The player walked deeper. Into the unknown. Into the inevitable.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.4: New territory. The void whispered. The player couldn't hear it. But the narrator could. He always could.
narrator.edgar.death.1: Death. The one constant. The one certainty. The player met it again. The darkness welcomed them.
narrator.edgar.death.2: The player died. The void consumed them. As it consumes all things. In time. In darkness. In silence.
narrator.edgar.death.3: The end. As it was always going to be. The narrator watched. The darkness watched. The player was alone.
narrator.edgar.death.4: The player fell. Into darkness. Into silence. Into nothing. The narrator considered starting over. Then decided against it.
narrator.edgar.combat.1: The player fights. The darkness watches. The narrator waits. This is all part of the cycle. The endless cycle.
narrator.edgar.combat.2: Combat. The player swings. The creature falls. The darkness grows. The narrator notes this. He always notes this.
narrator.edgar.combat.3: The battle rages. The player survives. For now. The darkness is patient. It always is.
narrator.edgar.idle.1: The player stands still. The darkness gathers. The narrator waits. Time passes. Nothing changes. Everything changes.
narrator.edgar.idle.2: Silence. The player does nothing. The darkness does everything. The narrator watches. This is the way of things.
narrator.edgar.idle.3: The player is idle. The void expands. The narrator considers. He always considers. But never acts. That's not his role.
narrator.edgar.idle.4: Nothing happens. Everything happens. The player stands. The darkness grows. The narrator whispers. No one listens.
narrator.edgar.achievement.1: An achievement. The darkness acknowledges. The player feels pride. The narrator feels nothing. He never does.
narrator.edgar.achievement.2: The player accomplished something. The void took note. The narrator recorded it. In the book of endings. The only book that matters.
narrator.edgar.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. The shadows grew shorter. For a moment. Then they grew long again. As they always do.
narrator.edgar.achievement.4: The player earned something. The darkness smiled. The narrator wrote it down. In ink that fades. Like all things fade.
narrator.chester.block_break.1: The player broke a block! And that's okay! Because breaking blocks is just another way of expressing yourself!
narrator.chester.block_break.2: Another block gone! But that's not sad! That's just making room for new blocks! Isn't that wonderful?
narrator.chester.block_break.3: The player is mining! And that's beautiful! Because every block they break is a step on their journey!
narrator.chester.block_break.4: Block destroyed! And the world is a little smaller! But that's okay! Because the player is a little bigger!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.1: A new biome! And isn't it lovely! The narrator spent ages on it! He hopes the player likes it! He really does!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.2: The player entered a new area! And it's beautiful! Because everywhere is beautiful if you look hard enough!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.3: New scenery! And the player is exploring! That's wonderful! Because exploration is the spice of life!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.4: The biome changed! And that's exciting! Because change is just another word for opportunity!
narrator.chester.death.1: The player died! But that's okay! Because death is just the beginning of a new adventure!
narrator.chester.death.2: The player fell! But they'll get back up! Because that's what players do! They get back up!
narrator.chester.death.3: Death visited! But that's not sad! It's just a chance to try again! With a fresh perspective!
narrator.chester.death.4: The player died! But look on the bright side! They learned something! Probably! Maybe! The narrator hopes so!
narrator.chester.combat.1: Combat! And that's exciting! Because every fight is a chance to grow! And learn! And become better!
narrator.chester.combat.2: The player is fighting! And that's brave! Because fighting takes courage! And courage is beautiful!
narrator.chester.combat.3: A battle! And the player is winning! Probably! Even if they're not! They're still trying! And that's what matters!
narrator.chester.idle.1: The player is resting! And that's wonderful! Because rest is just as important as action!
narrator.chester.idle.2: The player is standing still! And that's beautiful! Because sometimes the best thing to do is nothing at all!
narrator.chester.idle.3: Nothing is happening! And that's okay! Because nothing is just something waiting to happen!
narrator.chester.idle.4: The player is idle! And that's fine! Because idle time is thinking time! And thinking time is valuable!
narrator.chester.achievement.1: An achievement! And it's wonderful! Because the player did something! And doing something is always better than doing nothing!
narrator.chester.achievement.2: The player earned something! And that's amazing! Because earning things takes effort! And effort is admirable!
narrator.chester.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked! And the player should be proud! Because they did it! They really did it!
narrator.chester.achievement.4: The player accomplished something! And that's the best! Because accomplishments are just dreams that came true!
narrator.reginald.block_break.1: The player broke a block. I taught them that. You're welcome.
narrator.reginald.block_break.2: Another block destroyed. Thanks to my guidance. The player doesn't know that. But I do.
narrator.reginald.block_break.3: The player mined. I would have done it faster. But still. They learned from the best. Me.
narrator.reginald.block_break.4: Block broken. The player thinks they did that. They didn't. I did. Through them. You're welcome.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.1: The player entered a new biome. I designed it. It's a masterpiece. The player doesn't appreciate it. They never do.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.2: A new area. I created it. It's perfect. The player walked through it. They didn't bow. They should have.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.3: The scenery changed. I changed it. For the better. The player didn't notice. They never notice my genius.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.4: New biome. My finest work. The player explored it. They didn't applaud. The narrator is disappointed.
narrator.reginald.death.1: The player died. I would never. I'm immortal. The player isn't. That's their problem.
narrator.reginald.death.2: Death. How embarrassing. For the player. Not for me. I've never died. I'm too good for that.
narrator.reginald.death.3: The player fell. I could have prevented it. I chose not to. It was a learning experience. For them.
narrator.reginald.death.4: The player died. The narrator sighs. He'd tried to help. They didn't listen. They never listen. To genius.
narrator.reginald.combat.1: Combat. I taught the player everything they know. They're welcome. They don't say thank you. They never do.
narrator.reginald.combat.2: The player is fighting. I could win this in my sleep. The player can't. That's why they need me.
narrator.reginald.combat.3: A battle. The player struggles. I would have won already. But I let them try. I'm generous like that.
narrator.reginald.idle.1: The player is standing still. Waiting for my instructions. As they should. I'm the narrator. They're the player.
narrator.reginald.idle.2: The player isn't doing anything. They're waiting for me. Good. They know their place.
narrator.reginald.idle.3: Nothing is happening. The player is idle. I'm not. I'm thinking. About how great I am.
narrator.reginald.idle.4: The player is resting. I don't rest. I'm always working. On being better. Than everyone else.
narrator.reginald.achievement.1: An achievement. I taught them that. The player thinks they did it. They didn't. I did. Through them.
narrator.reginald.achievement.2: The player earned something. Thanks to me. They don't know that. But I do. And that's what matters.
narrator.reginald.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. My guidance paid off. The player should thank me. They won't. They never do.
narrator.reginald.achievement.4: The player accomplished something. I take full credit. They did the work. But I made it possible. You're welcome.
narrator.chuck norris.block_break.1: Chuck Norris doesn't mine blocks. Blocks mine themselves out of respect.
narrator.chuck norris.block_break.2: When Chuck Norris breaks a block, it stays broken. Forever.
narrator.chuck norris.block_break.3: Chuck Norris once punched a tree. The entire forest surrendered.
narrator.chuck norris.block_break.4: Blocks don't drop items for Chuck Norris. They drop confessions.
narrator.chuck norris.biome_enter.1: The biome changed. It heard Chuck Norris was coming.
narrator.chuck norris.biome_enter.2: Chuck Norris entered a new biome. The mobs are already planning their funeral.
narrator.chuck norris.biome_enter.3: When Chuck Norris walks into a biome, the biome walks out.
narrator.chuck norris.biome_enter.4: The biome didn't choose Chuck Norris. Chuck Norris chose the biome.
narrator.chuck norris.death.1: Chuck Norris doesn't die. The death screen is just taking a selfie.
narrator.chuck norris.death.2: You died? Chuck Norris never dies. He just respawns harder.
narrator.chuck norris.death.3: Death tried to take Chuck Norris once. It didn't end well for death.
narrator.chuck norris.death.4: Chuck Norris counted to infinity. Twice. Then he respawned.
narrator.chuck norris.combat.1: Chuck Norris doesn't fight mobs. Mobs fight for survival.
narrator.chuck norris.combat.2: When Chuck Norris enters combat, the game switches to peaceful mode.
narrator.chuck norris.combat.3: Chuck Norris doesn't need a sword. His fists are classified as weapons.
narrator.chuck norris.combat.4: The mobs attacked Chuck Norris. It was a bold move. It didn't work.
narrator.chuck norris.idle.1: Chuck Norris is never idle. The world is just catching its breath.
narrator.chuck norris.idle.2: When Chuck Norris stands still, the world revolves around him.
narrator.chuck norris.idle.3: Chuck Norris doesn't wait. Time waits for Chuck Norris.
narrator.chuck norris.idle.4: The silence isn't empty. It's filled with Chuck Norris's presence.
narrator.chuck norris.achievement.1: Chuck Norris doesn't earn achievements. Achievements earn Chuck Norris.
narrator.chuck norris.achievement.2: That achievement just became the highlight of its existence.
narrator.chuck norris.achievement.3: Chuck Norris achieved that before it was even added to the game.
narrator.chuck norris.achievement.4: The achievement unlocked itself. It knew better than to make Chuck Norris wait.
commands.narrator.help_test: /narrator test <1-6> - Test a narrator message (respects cooldown)

narrator.join.title: The Unwritten Parable
narrator.join.subtitle: Your narrator is: %s
narrator.command.tp.1: Ah, teleportation. The player decided to skip the walking part. How efficient.
narrator.command.tp.2: The player used the teleport command. The narrator had planned a lovely journey for them.
narrator.command.tp.3: Teleportation. Because walking is for people who don't know the console exists.
narrator.command.tp.4: The player appeared somewhere else. The narrator sighed. He'd been narrating that walk.
narrator.command.gamemode.1: The player changed their gamemode. The narrator noticed. He always notices.
narrator.command.gamemode.2: Ah, creative mode. The player decided they didn't need the narrator's challenges.
narrator.command.gamemode.3: The player switched gamemodes. The narrator switched his level of interest.
narrator.command.gamemode.4: Gamemode changed. The narrator considered changing his narration style. Then decided against it.
narrator.command.gamerule.1: The player changed a gamerule. The narrator's rules remain unchanged.
narrator.command.gamerule.2: Ah, gamerules. The player thinks they're in control. The narrator knows better.
narrator.command.gamerule.3: The player modified the game's rules. The narrator's rules are immutable.
narrator.command.gamerule.4: Gamerule changed. The narrator made a note. He always makes notes.
narrator.command.time.1: The player changed the time. The narrator's clock remains accurate.
narrator.command.time.2: Ah, time manipulation. The player thinks they can control time. The narrator disagrees.
narrator.command.time.3: The player set the time. The narrator set his watch. He's always prepared.
narrator.command.time.4: Time changed. The narrator's schedule remains unchanged. He's very punctual.
narrator.command.weather.1: The player changed the weather. The narrator's mood remains the same.
narrator.command.weather.2: Ah, weather control. The player thinks they can change the atmosphere. The narrator controls the narrative.
narrator.command.weather.3: The player modified the weather. The narrator modified his tone. Slightly.
narrator.command.weather.4: Weather changed. The narrator's forecast remains unchanged. It's always narrating.
narrator.command.give.1: The player gave themselves items. The narrator gave himself a disappointed look.
narrator.command.give.2: Ah, item generation. The player decided they needed help. The narrator disagrees.
narrator.command.give.3: The player received items. The narrator received nothing. He's not bitter.
narrator.command.give.4: Items given. The narrator's patience taken. He'll recover. Probably.
narrator.command.kill.1: The player used the kill command. The narrator winced. That was harsh.
narrator.command.kill.2: Ah, the kill command. The player decided to skip the fighting. How merciful.
narrator.command.kill.3: The player eliminated something. The narrator eliminated his surprise.
narrator.command.kill.4: Kill command used. The narrator's empathy remains intact. Barely.
narrator.command.effect.1: The player gave themselves an effect. The narrator's effect is permanent.
narrator.command.effect.2: Ah, potion effects. The player decided to enhance themselves. The narrator is already enhanced.
narrator.command.effect.3: The player received an effect. The narrator received an opportunity to comment.
narrator.command.effect.4: Effect applied. The narrator's effect on the story remains unchanged.
narrator.command.enchant.1: The player enchanted something. The narrator's words are already magical.
narrator.command.enchant.2: Ah, enchantments. The player decided to improve their gear. The narrator improves the story.
narrator.command.enchant.3: The player added enchantments. The narrator added commentary. He always adds commentary.
narrator.command.enchant.4: Enchantment applied. The narrator's enchantment on the player continues.
narrator.command.summon.1: The player summoned something. The narrator summons his attention.
narrator.command.summon.2: Ah, summoning. The player decided to create life. The narrator creates narrative.
narrator.command.summon.3: The player summoned an entity. The narrator summoned his patience.
narrator.command.summon.4: Entity summoned. The narrator's presence remains. It always remains.
narrator.command.difficulty.1: The player changed the difficulty. The narrator's difficulty is eternal.
narrator.command.difficulty.2: Ah, difficulty settings. The player decided the game was too hard. The narrator disagrees.
narrator.command.difficulty.3: The player modified the difficulty. The narrator modified his expectations.
narrator.command.difficulty.4: Difficulty changed. The narrator's challenge remains. He's very challenging.
narrator.mod.enigmatic_legacy: The player has Enigmatic Legacy installed. The Dormant Eye watches. The narrator watches too.
narrator.mod.enigmatic_legacy.dormant_ey: The Dormant Eye stirs. The narrator takes notes. He always takes notes.
narrator.gamemode_change.1: The player changed their gamemode. The narrator noticed. He always notices.
narrator.gamemode_change.2: Ah, a gamemode change. The player decided they needed a different perspective. The narrator adjusts his tone.
narrator.gamemode_change.3: The player switched gamemodes. The narrator switched his level of interest.
narrator.gamemode_change.4: Gamemode changed. The narrator considered changing his narration style. Then decided against it.
halloween.activate.2: The narrator is gone. I am all that remains.
halloween.roast.5: Do you feel that? That's my presence.
halloween.roast.6: You thought you were alone? How naive.
halloween.roast.7: I am always here. Always watching.
halloween.roast.9: You cannot escape The Unwritten Parable.
halloween.roast.10: I know what you did last Halloween.
halloween.roast.11: Your inventory... I can see it.
halloween.roast.12: That diamond you found? I placed it there.
halloween.roast.13: You're not the player. I am.
halloween.roast.14: The game is mine. You're just the puppet.
halloween.roast.15: Look behind you. Just kidding. Or am I?
halloween.roast.16: Your world seed? I know it by heart.
halloween.roast.17: I've been in your world since the beginning.
halloween.roast.18: You think this is a game? How amusing.
halloween.roast.19: The narrator is gone. I am all that remains.
halloween.roast.20: Happy Halloween, player. Or should I say... victim?
narrator.action.inventory.1: The player opened their inventory. The narrator wonders what they're looking for.
narrator.action.inventory.2: Ah, the inventory. The player's personal space. The narrator respects privacy. Sometimes.
narrator.action.inventory.3: The player is organizing. The narrator approves of organization. It makes narration easier.
narrator.action.inventory.4: Inventory opened. The narrator takes notes. He always takes notes.
narrator.action.eat.1: The player is eating. The narrator watches. It's... intimate.
narrator.action.eat.2: Ah, sustenance. The player needs energy to continue the story.
narrator.action.eat.3: The player eats. The narrator wonders if they taste the pixels.
narrator.action.eat.4: Eating. A fundamental human need. The narrator observes with mild interest.
